title: One quest icon legend per milestone
caption: The Lv 32 milestone explains the three regional quest icons once, under its first Regional quests heading, instead of under every one.

title: One quest icon legend on phones
caption: On a phone the Lv 32 milestone also shows the icon legend once, under the Lv 32 Regional quests heading only.

title: The header follows your class pick
caption: On the welcome card, picking the Ranger now renames the page title and the line above it to Ranger at once, before you press Start.

title: The header follows your pick on phones
caption: On a phone, picking the Ranger on the welcome card also renames the title to Asmodian Ranger Route right away.
